items.source_en:
Date: 5-22-2324
Codename: CAPS 
Location: Promenade
Operator: Dr. Joseph Leonard

Diagnostic tests of the CAPS (Complete Autopilot System) are clear. Simulations have all completed successfully; the program is able to identify how to jump from system to system in optimal patterns--Linda's algorithm for the Travelling Salesman problem proved quite effective--and it is able to react to unforeseen obstacles, navigate around other ships, and radio with spaceports and Imperial Fleet officers.

In short: self-driving space craft have just become a reality.

All that's left now is to test the maiden voyage. Then on to fame and fortune. And making the world a better place.

CAPS(완전 자동 조종 시스템)의 진단 테스트가 완료되었다. 시뮬레이션도 모두 성공적으로 끝났다. 프로그램은 성계 간 최적의 패턴으로 점프하는 방법을 식별할 수 있고(외판원 문제를 해결하기 위한 린다의 알고리즘이 매우 효과적이었다), 예상치 못한 장애물에 반응하고, 다른 함선을 피해 항해하며, 우주항 및 제국 함대 장교들과 무전 통신도 가능하다.

요컨대, 자율 주행 우주선이 현실이 된 것이다.

items.source_en:
I can't overstate how good it feels to be back in the starfield. And what a marvelous first stop, too. Six Sisters really does have a nose for great sites. I'm sure the miners who end up here will be thrilled. As thrilled as miners get, anyway. 

I'd almost forgotten how gorgeous the night sky is without light pollution. I'm glad I brought along my telescope, I've seen some real wonders in the last few nights. Dr. Porter was right about that astronomy minor. It really does come in handy when you least expect it.

This planet's iron-rich soil reminds me so much of home. I hate to admit it, but leaving Geonosis Excavation Site behind wasn't as easy as I hoped. I think about Cassie all the time. She'd adore this place. I hope my sketches can do it justice.

I'm scheduled to depart tomorrow. Fingers crossed that my next site will be as beautiful as this one.

다시 별들 사이로 돌아오니 이보다 더 좋을 수가 없다. 첫 번째 정착지부터 정말 훌륭하다. 식스 시스터즈는 정말 좋은 장소를 찾는 안목이 있다. 이곳에 오게 될 광부들도 분명 기뻐할 것이다. 광부들이 기뻐해 봐야 거기서 거기겠지만.

빛 공해 없는 밤하늘이 얼마나 아름다운지 거의 잊고 있었다. 망원경을 가져오길 정말 잘했다. 지난 며칠 밤 동안 정말 경이로운 것들을 많이 보았다. 포터 박사가 천문학 부전공을 하라고 했던 말이 맞았다. 예상치 못한 순간에 정말 유용하게 쓰인다.

내일 떠날 예정이다. 다음 장소도 이곳만큼 아름답기를 바랄 뿐이다.

items.source_en:
Commercial Reproductions of Taris Fauna

Throughout human history, replicas of Taris animals were used in many different ways, from toys and games, to more practical uses such as these items. 

Piggy Bank, Left.
As far back as the 15th century, hollowed-out ceramic statue of the animal known as "pig" were popularly used to store physical currency.

Decoy Duck, Right.
Water fowl, known as "ducks" were once hunted near Taris's marshes for sport and food using ballistic rifles. To facilitate this activity, hunters would often place wooden decoy ducks in the water and use a small woodwind instrument to produce an accompanying call resembling that of the duck in order to lure it in.

인류 역사 전반에 걸쳐 타리스 동물의 복제품은 장난감이나 게임부터 이 전시품처럼 실용적인 용도까지 다양하게 사용되었습니다.

오른쪽, 오리 미끼.

From: Leanna Ziremi
Subject: RE: Rules of Engagement

Wynn, 
Yeah, I have your stuff.  

But after what you did, and who you did it with, I don't want to see you ever again. If I'm in the Mess Hall, you need to be in your bunk. If I'm in the Cargo Bay, you need to be in your bunk. Because if I so much as see your face again, I'm going to discharge my blaster right in your teeth.
